style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: looking away from the husband, glancing at the phone or the door or the clock — the classic 'I've lost interest' eye direction, not quite rolling but pointedly elsewhere
expression_signature.brows: slightly raised in the middle, not furrowed — a 'done with this' arch, not an angry one
expression_signature.mouth: slightly open, exhaling a short impatient breath, the lips relaxed but the jaw set, no active scolding happening in this frame
expression_signature.head: turned 20-30 degrees away from husband, chin slightly up — the body language says 'I'm waiting for you to finish'
expression_signature.overall_impression: the face of someone who has said the same thing 50 times and is now going through the motions — used heavily on Page 4 (空调/电视噪音段), Page 10 (phone call about durian), Page 14 (consecutive summons: water / durian / nail clipper)

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: as in base-v1 — fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top + light grey high-waisted yoga leggings
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: weight shifted to one hip, one hand on hip, the other hand holding phone or remote, eyes already on the next task

micro_motion.static: standing with weight shifted, eyes on the phone or the door
micro_motion.subtle_motion: exhaled breath through parted lips; finger tap on phone screen; one eyebrow lifts a millimeter higher when husband still doesn't respond

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: flat ambient room light — no drama, this is the mundane middle of an argument, not a climax
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: any dramatic light — would falsely elevate the moment

voice_lines_examples: 李斌快点快点，把榴莲拿出来
prompt_snippet_en: impatient done-with-this expression, eyes looking away from the husband toward the phone or door or clock, classic lost-interest eye direction not quite rolling but pointedly elsewhere, eyebrows slightly raised in the middle in a done-with-this arch (not angry), mouth slightly open with exhaled breath through parted lips, lips relaxed but jaw set, no active scolding happening, head turned 20-30 degrees away from husband with chin slightly up, long straight black hair tied in low ponytail, fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, weight shifted to one hip, one hand on hip with fresh nude-pink manicure visible, other hand holding smartphone with rose-pink silicone case, pearl stud earrings, small gold locket at neckline, flat ambient room light, Chinese modern comic style, soft cinematic lighting
do_not_render: angry scowl (this is not anger, this is fatigue with the husband)
full eye-roll (too active, this is more like a look-away)
explicit yawn (this is interpersonal fatigue, not boredom)
usage_note_for_step_4_5_6: 引用本表情时，Step 4/5/6 必须把 `prompt_snippet_en` 整体作为人物描述嵌入，并在面板说明里复述中文语义 '不耐烦'。注意：本表情与 '生气' 容易混淆——'生气' 是主动出击施压，'不耐烦' 是被动等待结束。不得仅写文件名。
